what: Video and photo panels slightly taller than the screen (default +10rem) pass by joined end to end. Each panel draws only its own inside with clip-path, so the title line stays pinned at the panel center and switches to the next title when the next panel’s edge passes. The image inside a panel scales 1 → 1.1x and shifts -30% → 30% following the progress p of the panel crossing the screen — no curve, directly tied to scroll

options.zoom: Share that grows beyond progress 1, default .1
options.--fx-extra: How much the panel is taller than the screen, default 10rem
options.--fx-veil: Dark overlay opacity over the image, default .2
